Game Overview

Jake Black Cat 2 puts players into a adventure experience centered on embark on a daring adventure with Jake Black Cat, navigating through perilous 2D platforming challenges. Collect bowls of cat food while dodging rival cats, flying adversaries, and traps. Master the art of timing and use your double jump skillfully to survive eight thrilling levels and reach home safely.
